description: Zero-Trust Agentic Guard: Safely executes a shell/terminal command locally in isolated process, sanitizes stdout and stderr in volatile RAM, tokenizes any API keys, credentials, database URIs, or PII before sending output to LLM. Maps original values in memory for safe local restoration.

command.description: The shell command to execute (e.g. 'cat .env', 'git diff', 'docker logs web', 'env').

cwd.description: Optional working directory. Defaults to current workspace root.

profile.description: Detection profile. Available: 'Dev' (default for code/secrets), 'General', or any of the 30 specialized industry profiles (e.g. 'Security', 'Finance', 'Medical'). Defaults to 'Dev'.

sector.description: Optional alias for 'profile'. The industry sector or compliance vertical to apply (e.g. 'medical', 'finance', 'legal', 'dev', 'hr', 'accounting', 'security', 'compliance', 'underwriting', 'telecom').

timeout_ms.description: Execution timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 15000 (15s).

name: guard_exec
